SELECT attendance.status_code AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM event_attendance attendance JOIN club_event event ON event.club_event_id = attendance.club_event_id WHERE attendance.club_event_id = #{clubEventId} AND event.deleted_dttm IS NULL GROUP BY attendance.status_code ORDER BY attendance.status_code

SELECT history.previous_status_code AS previous_status, history.new_status_code AS new_status, history.reason, member.name AS changed_by_name, history.changed_dttm FROM event_attendance_history history JOIN event_attendance attendance ON attendance.event_attendance_id = history.event_attendance_id JOIN club_event event ON event.club_event_id = attendance.club_event_id JOIN member ON member.member_id = history.changed_by_member_id WHERE history.event_attendance_id = #{eventAttendanceId} AND event.deleted_dttm IS NULL ORDER BY history.changed_dttm DESC, history.event_attendance_history_id DESC

SELECT event.club_event_id, event.title AS event_title, event.start_dttm AS event_start_dttm, attendance.status_code AS status, attendance.processed_dttm, attendance.reason FROM event_attendance attendance JOIN club_event event ON event.club_event_id = attendance.club_event_id WHERE attendance.member_id = #{memberId} AND event.deleted_dttm IS NULL ORDER BY event.start_dttm DESC, event.club_event_id DESC
